page_description: Share budgets, expenses and goals with the people you love. Create a family account or join one, and chart the route of your money together.
list_empty_title: You don't have a family account yet
list_empty_description: Create a new family account or accept an invitation you've received.
personal_mode_hint: Only you can see your records. Pick a family account from the tabs above to manage it, or create a new one.
create_modalSubtitle: Give the family a name first, then invite members.
create_transferQuestion: What should happen to your existing personal data?
create_transferOption_none: Keep personal — only new records are added to the family (recommended)
create_transferOption_move: MOVE to the family — existing personal records move to the family, personal account empties
create_transferHint_none: Your existing category/transaction/budget/goal/debt/recurring records stay personal. Only new records you add while the family is active become family records. You can move a record to the family later, one by one.
create_transferHint_move: ⚠️ Your existing personal category/transaction/budget/goal/debt/recurring records are MOVED to the family and everyone in the family sees them. Your personal account empties. To undo, move the record back to personal one by one.
move_toFamily: Move this record to the family — everyone in the family sees it
move_toPersonal: Make this record personal — only you see it
move_noCategory: No category of this type in the target scope. Create one there first.
member_transferOwnership_confirm: Are you sure you want to transfer ownership to {{name}}? This cannot be undone; you'll be demoted to Member.
invite_scanHint: Scan with a phone camera to open the invite.
invite_shareText: You're invited to the {{name}} family account. Open the link to join:
accept_pageSubtitle: You're about to gain access to all shared records of the family that invited you.
accept_invalid: Invitation is invalid or has expired
accept_emailMismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email
accept_already: You're already a member of this family
accept_appPrompt: Get the ParaRotam app to manage your invitation on your phone
leave_modalSubtitle: How you leave determines what happens to the shared data.
leave_mode_transfer_hint: Transfer ownership to a member you select. You leave; the family and all shared data remain.
leave_mode_personal_hint: Hand all shared family data over to each member's personal account (HouseholdId NULL). The family is deleted, everyone continues with their own records.
leave_mode_delete_hint: All shared categories/transactions/budgets/goals/recurring records of the family are deleted. This cannot be undone.
leave_onlyOwner_hint: You're the only member — you can only delete or take the data for yourself.
remove_confirmBody: {{name}} will be removed from the family. Records this member added to the family will return to their personal account.
locked_hint: Without premium you can't access family data; you can leave a family below if you wish.
locked_ownerNote: You own this family — to leave, transfer ownership first (requires premium).
locked_leaveConfirm: Leave the "{{name}}" family? Records you moved to the family stay with it.
locked_leaveError: Could not leave the family, please try again.
